page.layout: One page of text, single column; a brace-grouped table of verb forms set in a narrow block with bracketed labels in the left margin (VI, MI TI, MI SI) beside the braces. Running head at top with page number at top right.

main_text.l: Vos, Vi percósse Percósseui: vos percussit.
Vobis: Vi diéde Diédeui: dedit vobis.
Illic, vel illuc: Vifu, Fúuui: illic fuit: Viando, Andóuui: iuit illuc.
main_text.p: Porrò hæ particulæ inuicem conne-ctuntur, & ita non raró orationem ingrediuntur haud mediocri cum elegantia: quod quomodo fiat, ex typis infrà positis facillimè intelligetur.
main_text.l: Me tibi: Iomiti raccomándo, & Raccomándomiti: me tibi commendo.
Mihi te: Tu mitiraccomandásti, & Raccomandástimiti: Mihi te commendasti.
Me sibi: E'gli misi elésse, Eléssemisi per grandíssimo amíco: is me sibi amicum summum elegit.
Mihi se: E'gli misi raccomandò, Raccomandómisi: is mihi se commendauit

page.notes: Bracket labels VI, MI TI and MI SI in the left margin belong to the brace groups. Forms are set in italic and roman mixed type; some words are partly obscured near the bottom right (commendauit reads "commendauit" with a smudged first letter). Long s rendered as plain s throughout.
